mapper.select: SELECT code, audience, kind, name_zh, name_en, title_zh, title_en, body_zh, body_en, variables, channels, built_in, enabled FROM notify_template WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT push_enabled, email_enabled, lang FROM notify_pref WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_pref (user_id, push_enabled, email_enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{push}, #{email}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE push_enabled = VALUES(push_enabled), email_enabled = VALUES(email_enabled)
INSERT INTO notify_pref (user_id, lang) VALUES (#{userId}, #{lang}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE lang = VALUES(lang)
INSERT INTO notify_message (user_id, kind, template_code, params, title, body, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{templateCode}, #{params}, #{title}, #{body}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, kind, template_code, params, title, body, read_at, created_at FROM notify_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notify_message WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notify_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notify_message SET read_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
UPDATE notify_message SET read_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_record (user_id, recipient, source, template_code, channel, title, status, error, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recipient}, #{source}, #{templateCode}, #{channel}, #{title}, #{status}, #{error}, #{operatorId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE notify_record SET status = #{status}, error = #{error} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, recipient, source, template_code, channel, title, status, error, operator_id, created_at FROM notify_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
